entry: Consumer behavior: a Repair & Reuse Culture campaign trims the material each cycle needs by 4% per level, a demand-side lever beside the supply-side measures (H17).
Supply chain redesign: once your loop has closed, redesign each measure up to three times for a permanent +5% supply per level (H3).
Circularity scorecard: your circular share against the overall real-world figure and every sector benchmark at once, with a verdict and bars for each (H19).
Waste-stream focus: pick one of Repair, Reuse or Recycling to count 25% higher, free to switch at any time (H9).

Two optional start modes: a Circular design challenge (all circular supply counts at 65%) and a Zero-waste challenge (keep lifetime extraction under 150 units), picked before the first cycle (H13, H23).
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).
Fixed the chain-flow visualization overflowing the screen edge on narrow phones.

Each goods-flavor set (electronics/clothing/furniture) now has its own distinct loop story, not just a different noun in the same sentence. The achievement-unlock toast also no longer overlaps with the loop-closed banner.
Fixed a display bug where the Achievements/What's New panels showed as empty boxes before their first open and never visually closed again once opened once.
H5: a new live comparison shows how your lifetime circular share stacks up against other players', once enough chains have been saved to compare against.

Z22 confirmation-dialog audit: "Start New Chain" now goes through the shared ConfirmDialog (matching Grid/Herd/Trade Empire) instead of firing instantly, since it's a full wipe of the current chain's funds, cycle, and investments.

Round-2 wave: a third trade partner (Overseas Consortium), a 25% milestone particle burst, ring-node glow on your top investment, a loop efficiency audit, score-source pie, streak progress, extraction-cost trend arrow, cosmetic goods relabel, a weekly featured category, and a Goods Collector achievement.
Added tooltips to the Trade Link and Regional Partner buttons explaining what each actually buys, closing an onboarding gap for players who skipped the tutorial.

Added a settings panel (text size + reduced motion) and completed a colorblind-safety audit — the linear-chain brown vs. closed-loop green flow particle is already redundantly coded via text and arrow brightness, no change needed.

Achievements system added (20 achievements) plus a large H1-H20 backlog pass: a goods-category picker, a second trade partner, a closed-loop streak tracker, a live score breakdown, and reactive visual pulses on investment.
Full visual redesign: starfield/space-themed backdrop, glass panels, gradient buttons and glowing meter fills.
Fixed load_state() wholesale-replacing circularity investments on load instead of merging key-by-key against the current investment schema.
Pass 3 balance check: confirmed the single-item vignette already gives immediate, strategy-reflective feedback tied to the live circular-supply fraction; added regression tests to lock it in.
Added an in-game Info Page with real-world circular-economy sources; Pass 2 added a trade network and a single-item vignette alongside the abstract flow-chain view.
Iteration pass: animated chain-flow particles (color-coded circular vs. linear paths) and an end-of-session real-world circularity-rate comparison.

All 7 core milestones shipped: linear extraction chain, circularity investments, environmental cost meter, loop-closure visualization, scoring + hope-angle payoff, feedback prompt, and hub integration.
